title: Relationship Between Pleural Elastance and Effectiveness of Pleurodesis on Recurrent Malignant Pleural Effusion
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to analyze the correlation between pleural elastance and the radiological effectiveness (measured by chest tomography) of pleurodesis performed via catheters in patients with RMPE. The secondary objectives of this study are: correlate pleural elastance with quality of life, analysis of dyspnea and pain after the procedure, clinical effectiveness, complications and mortality in 30 days.
study_population: Patients with malignant pleural effusion diagnosed by pleural fluid cytology and / or pleural biopsy
